body.name: shared estimated-influence multiplier bootstrap
body.construction: Form every optimizer-influence coordinate with the total ridge convention \((\widehat H_c^{\mathrm{tot}})^{-1}\), center the resulting foldwise plug-in vectors to obtain \(\widetilde\Psi_i(c)\), draw one common multiplier vector \((\xi_1,\ldots,\xi_n)\), and calculate \(G_n^*(c)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\xi_i\widetilde\Psi_i(c)\) for every \(c\in\mathcal C\). The same totalized influences define \(\widehat\Gamma\) and \(G_n^*\).
